note: Asking prices in euros from the original listing on the day each home was added. Medians describe the homes RealHunt lists (cheap for their country, checked by a person), not a country's whole market. Rules, taxes and costs are general information, not legal or tax advice.
sentences: On 28 November 2026, RealHunt lists 4 homes for sale in Thailand, each one checked by a person.
In Thailand, the median asking price of those 4 homes is €76,700 (€1,237 per m², from the 4 homes with a known size); the cheapest costs €60,392 and the most expensive €139,500.
With 4 homes this is a small sample, so the median for Thailand is a rough guide.

homes.title: Move-in ready furnished 3-bedroom house with garden and parking in Saraphi, Chiang Mai
homes.title_es: Casa de 3 dormitorios lista para entrar a vivir con jardín y aparcamiento en Saraphi, Chiang Mai
homes.summary: This move-in ready single-storey house is furnished, so it can be lived in now. It has 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, a living room with a dining area and a kitchen with a counter. Outdoor features include a small garden beside the house, parking for 2 cars and land of 252 sq m. It is close to Nam Thong Market, Wachiralai School, Saraphi Hospital and Thong Floating Market, with convenient access to Chiang Mai city. Asking €65,664, about €469/m².

homes.title: Furnished corner townhouse with pool and air conditioning in Min Buri, Bangkok
homes.title_es: Casa adosada esquinera amueblada con piscina y aire acondicionado en Min Buri, Bangkok
homes.summary: This is a 2-storey townhouse in a corner unit in Min Buri, Bangkok, with a usable area of 140 square metres. It has 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms, plus 1 parking space. The home includes furniture, a sofa, dining table set, bed and wardrobe, and electrical appliances. Air conditioning is installed, and the project has a swimming pool and a public park nearby. It is near MRT Pink Line Talad Min Buri Station, and it faces north with an extended rear roof. Asking €60,392, about €431/m².

homes.title: Renovated two-bedroom condo with pool and gym near Chiang Mai Night Bazaar
homes.title_es: Apartamento de dos dormitorios renovado con piscina y gimnasio cerca del Night Bazaar de Chiang Mai
homes.summary: A 62 m² apartment with two bedrooms and two bathrooms on the 2nd floor of Tree Boutique Resort, a 77-unit building completed in 2017 in Chang Khlan, a walk from the Night Bazaar. The advert says it was fully renovated and is sold fully furnished, with a balcony. The building has a pool, gym, garden, parking and 24-hour security. Listed under the foreign freehold quota. Asking US$84,300 (about €76,700), around €1,240/m². The monthly common fee is not clearly stated in the advert, so ask the seller.

homes.title: Two-bedroom 85 m² pool-view condo from 2012 near Khao Takiab beach, Hua Hin
homes.title_es: Condominio de dos dormitorios 85 m² con vistas a la piscina cerca de la playa Khao Takiab, Hua Hin
homes.place: Khao Takiab, Hua Hin, Prachuap Khiri Khan
homes.summary: An 85.3 m² condo with two bedrooms and two bathrooms on the 6th floor of The Seacraze, a low-rise building from 2012 a short walk from Khao Takiab beach in Hua Hin. A patio looks over the large swimming pool and the flat is sold furnished. The complex has a pool, gym, kids room, key-card access, CCTV and 24-hour security. The unit is offered under the foreign quota, so a foreigner can own it freehold. Asking 5,200,000 baht (about €139,500), roughly €1,640/m². Maintenance: 45 baht per m² a month (about 3,840 baht or €103). Transfer costs shared 50/50.
